title: Curling is about touch and tactics, not strength, and you can slide your first stone within the hour
alt: Dozens of rounded granite curling stones in grey, pink and white, arranged in tiers on a bed of gravel beside a lawn.

posts.facebook:
You may have seen it at the Winter Olympics: players sliding heavy granite stones down the ice while teammates sweep hard in front of them.

It's a game of touch and tactics more than strength. Two teams of four aim at a target on the ice called the house. Sweeping changes how far each stone travels and how much it curls.

At a beginners' taster session you'll be sliding your first stone within the hour, with brushes, sliders and stones supplied. Rinks have ice from fall to spring.

Would you have a go?

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/try-curling/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
